motions.motion: APPROVE the Conceptual Plan and Preliminary Plat application by David George for Bella Casa, a two-lot, detached single-family residential subdivision, located at 4555 South Highland Drive, in the R-2-10 Zone, based on the following: Findings: 1. The submitted documents for a residential subdivision in the R-2-10 Zone are substantially complete. 2. Each proposed lot exceeds the minimum standards for single-family home development in the R-2-10 Zone. 3. The development complies with the General Plan by providing single-family homes on lots similar to development within the vicinity. 4. The development and construction requirements are proposed within the project boundaries. They do not require neighboring contributions or agreements and are found to be substantially complete. 5. Fire access has been approved by the Unified Fire Authority ("UFA"). 6. Direct and unobstructed vehicular access and utility easements to the rear home are already established. City of Holladay Planning Commission Meeting -07/12/2022 6 The motion was subject to the following Conditions of Approval: 1. That an Irrigation Protection Agreement or irrigation protection letter be completed between the City and the property owner. 2. That the owner of the property submits the required Landscaping Plan for review and verification by the TRC, including all tree canopy preservation details. 3. Stormwater detention areas and public improvements must be submitted for review and verification by the City Engineer. 4. Final water utility connection letters will be obtained prior to the Final Plat submittal to the TRC. 5. Post Development Bonding requirements, as determined by the City Engineer. 6. Within one year, and in accordance with 13.08.010.D5, to defer administrative review and approval of the Final Plat by the Community and Economic Development Director, following a positive, written recommendation from the TRC

motions.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Commission.
The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Commission.
